parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key, 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters (a UUID per logical submit). A retry with the same key and the same request replays the first response with `Idempotency-Replayed true` when it was a 2xx or a refusal that is final for the request (`invalid-cover-days`, `invalid-sscc`); the same key on a different method, path or body is `409 idempotency-key-reused`. A refusal that depends on state that can change (`validation-failed`, `case-pack-not-uniform`, `case-qty-mismatches-gtin`, `carton-overweight`, `carton-oversize`, `carton-contents-mismatch-plan`, `inbound-capacity-exceeded`, `network-split-destination`, `network-split-unavailable`, `not-found`, `seller-suspended`, `seller-exists`, `node-cannot-receive`, `sscc-not-unique`, `shipment-not-labelled`, `illegal-transition` and `concurrent-update`) and every 5xx is not stored, so the key is released, the retry executes again, and a different request under a released key is a new request, not `idempotency-key-reused`.
